outline:
This course introduces the concepts and applications of marketing research. This course emphasizes the basic research design and data analysis methodologies. This course is designed to
‧	provide a basic understanding of research methodology and its implementation in marketing
‧	understand the role, scope, and process of marketing research, and
‧	enable the student to do real marketing research.
This course emphasizes an applied approach with practical applications of marketing research in management.
schedule:
Week 1	Class introduction
Week 2	Ch1 Marketing Review and Introduction to Marketing Research
Week 3	Ch2 & 3 Defining the Marketing Research Problem and Developing an Approach
Week 4	Ch4	& 5 Exploratory Research Design
Week 5	Exam 1 & Ch6  Descriptive Research Design
Week 5	Ch7 Casual Research
Week 6	Ch8 & 9 Measurement and Scaling
Week 7	No class (Tomb-Sweeping Day)
Week 8	Ch10 Questionnaire Design and Form Design
Week 9	Ch11&12 Sampling
Week 10 Exam2 & Ch15 Frequency Distribtuion, Cross-Tabulation, and Hypothesis Testing
Week 11	Ch16 Analysis of Variance and Covariance
Week 12	Ch17 Correlation and Regression
Week 13	Ch18 Discriminant and Logit Analysis
Week 14	Ch19 Factor Analysis
Week 15	Ch20 Cluster Analysis
Week 16	Ch21 Multidimensional Scaling and Conjoint Analysis
Week 17	Ch22 Structural Equation Modeling and Path Analysis
Week 18	Case presentation
